articles.body:
Hi! What happens when the tail of the elephant is in a company controlled region facing an non-company controlled region and a crisis is draw? 

Also, i understand that there is a rebellion when a member of an empire is attacking it’s capital and i understand than there a invasion when an empire is attacking a non-empire region . 
But what happens when there is a crisis between 2 non empire regions?!

articles.body:
[q="Brade56"]But what happens when there is a crisis between 2 non empire regions?![/q]

If they are sovereign regions, one tries to invade the other and could form a new empire.

Whenever the elephant's tail would be in a Company-controlled region, it instead moves to the inside of the region to show a looming rebellion against the Company.

This occurs even if the Elephant was on the border when the region became a Company-controlled region.

articles.body:
A dominated region is dominated because it is part of an Empire (but not the Capital) or because it is a company-controlled region. If it's part of an empire, it rebels against the capital. If it's a company-controlled region, it rebels against the company.

It took me a while to understand this.
